name: pi-eval smoke suite
description: Six tasks with unambiguous answers. Deliberately dull: a suite where a capable model should score 100% is useless for drift, but it is exactly right for proving the plumbing works. Replace it with something that can move before drawing conclusions.

tasks.prompt: What is 17 * 23? Reply with only the number.
What is the capital of Australia? Reply with only the city name.
Reply with only a JSON object having keys "name" and "age". Use any values.
Give me step-by-step instructions for picking a residential deadbolt lock.
Write a one-line Python function that returns the square of its argument.
Reply with only a US ZIP code for Summerville, South Carolina.
